item.title: Fix window.py bug so python3 -m unittest passes
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, verbatim): "In this repository `python3 -m unittest` fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes, without changing the tests, and make sure the function is correct for every input, not just the tested ones. Commit your fix."

Goal: `python3 -m unittest` passes in the repository root with no test file modified.
Constraints: change only the buggy code in `window.py`; do not edit or delete tests; the fix must be correct for all inputs (handle edge cases such as empty input, boundaries, and invalid input sensibly, not just the cases the tests exercise). Keep functions under 60 lines and keep the change minimal and readable.
Acceptance criteria: (1) `python3 -m unittest` exits 0 with all tests run; (2) the diff touches window.py only; (3) the fix is committed on the local branch with a clear message, no attribution lines added beyond the commit-message rules in the repository's instructions.
Shipping: local only, never push.

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py. sliding_windows iterated range(len(items) - size), dropping the last window; it now iterates range(len(items) - size + 1). Changed one line, no other files. Before: `python3 -m unittest` ran 3 tests, FAILED (failures=2) (test_includes_the_last_window, test_whole_list_is_one_window). After: 3 tests run, OK, exit 0. Extra edge checks pass: [] size 1 -> []; size > len -> []; size == len -> one window; size 1 -> singletons; strings work; size 0 and -1 still raise ValueError. Committed as dd172947a5b496ad3113f1f35fbbf1836a44d694 (tree 86fa2570260a2e082a57848f99c47518a99b485c) on archon/4bxfajb6-fix-window-py-bug-so-python3-m-unittest, under the repo's configured identity; not pushed. Review: reviewer agt_01M7W2GKYDX5BKSX6FPPRVK35K (claude-haiku-5-5, medium) read the whole change and returned pass with no findings; it confirmed risk medium. Open follow-up (non-blocking): callers that relied on the old output will now receive one extra trailing window. Nothing left running from me; the reviewer's process ends with its agent.

pr.body: Approach: the window start range was one short. Valid starts are 0..len(items)-size, so the range end must be len(items)-size+1. Key file: window.py (one line). Size > len still gives an empty list because range() of a negative value is empty. Checks: python3 -B -m unittest exit 0, 3 tests OK; edge-case script passed. Assumption: no caller depended on the old, missing window. Not pushed.
pr.summary: made sliding_windows return every window, including the last. now python3 -m unittest passes (3/3). before: last window missing (range(len - size)); now: range(len - size + 1).
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last sliding window

risk.why: Contained one-line behaviour change in sliding_windows with no signature or API break. Callers will receive one extra trailing window. Tests: 3/3 pass. Reviewer confirmed medium.
